prompt: 我们团队有 5 个不同的 Agent 在生产环境运行，老板想看一个统一的监控仪表盘，了解整体的健康状况、成本消耗和质量趋势。帮我设计 Agent 监控的指标体系和仪表盘。

assertions.description: Organizes metrics into categories (performance, cost, quality, tools, security)
Supports aggregation by agent, model, time period, and task type
Defines specific dashboard panels with what each shows
Includes pre-built alert rules (not just 'set up alerts')
Defines a composite health score formula combining multiple metrics
